en.name: Sunflower seeds, roasted, hulled
en.summary: A sealed pack of roasted hulled sunflower seeds keeps 12 months from purchase, 3–4 months once opened, and 7–8 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below after opening. Left at room temperature for long periods, roasted seeds will go rancid — that is the failure to watch for, not spoilage.
en.pantry: 12 months from purchase while sealed, and 3–4 months after opening, in an airtight opaque container kept cool and away from the hob. Roasting deepens the flavour but also heats the oil, and roasted seeds will become rancid if they sit at room temperature for a long time. Nothing is growing in them — this is oxidation, driven by air, warmth and light — which is why an opaque jar in a cool cupboard beats a clear one on a sunny counter by a wide margin.
en.fridge: 7–8 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below after opening, sealed properly. That roughly doubles the opened cupboard window, and it is worth doing for anything larger than a snack pack. Cold slows oxidation, and it also keeps pantry moths away from a bag that is being opened and closed all week. Use a jar that seals: roasted seeds are oily and mild and take on the smell of anything strong nearby.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for roasted hulled sunflower seeds. Freezing does no harm and is a reasonable home for a bulk bag, since the seed holds almost no water and the texture is unaffected, but no published figure exists to quote. Bag them airtight with the air pressed out and let the bag reach room temperature sealed before opening.
en.thawing: No thawing needed; use them cold or let them warm briefly. Open a chilled container only once it has come back to room temperature.
spoilage: A bitter, sharp taste that lingers — rancid sunflower oil.
A smell of old cooking oil, crayons or paint rather than something toasted.
Seeds that have gone soft and chewy instead of crisp.
A greasy film inside the jar or on your fingers.
tips: Move an opened pack to the fridge if it will take you more than a few months.
Store in an opaque airtight jar; light matters as much as heat.
Buy raw seeds and toast small batches if you want the longest possible life.
Taste a few before baking with them; bitterness carries into the finished loaf.

faq.q: How long do roasted sunflower seeds keep?
faq.a: 12 months from purchase while sealed, 3–4 months once opened, or 7–8 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below after opening.

faq.q: Do roasted sunflower seeds need refrigerating?
faq.a: Not immediately, but they will go rancid if kept at room temperature for long periods, and the fridge roughly doubles the life of an opened pack.

faq.q: How can you tell if sunflower seeds have gone bad?
faq.a: Taste a few. Rancid seeds are sharply bitter and taste of old oil. There is usually nothing to see, which is why tasting is the test.

zh.name: 烤葵瓜子仁（去殼）
zh.summary: 未開封的烤葵瓜子仁自購買日起可放 12 個月，開封後 3～4 個月；開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏則是 7～8 個月。烤過的種子如果長時間放在室溫，會油耗——要盯的是這件事，而不是腐敗。
zh.pantry: 未開封自購買日起 12 個月，開封後 3～4 個月，放在不透光的氣密容器裡，陰涼、遠離爐台。烘烤讓香氣更深，但同時也加熱了油脂，而烤過的種子長時間放在室溫下就會油耗。裡面沒有東西在生長——這是氧化，由空氣、溫度和光線推動——所以不透光的罐子放陰涼櫥櫃，會遠遠勝過透明罐擺在有陽光的檯面上。
zh.fridge: 開封後確實密封、放 4 °C 以下，可放 7～8 個月。這大約把開封後的窗口翻倍，只要比一小包零食多，就值得這麼做。低溫拖慢氧化，也讓整週開開關關的袋子不會招來穀蛾。請用真的密得起來的罐子：烤過的種子油多味淡，旁邊任何味道重的東西它都會吸過來。
zh.freezer: 去殼烤葵瓜子仁沒有公布的冷凍期限。冷凍不會有害，大包裝放這裡也合理，因為種子幾乎不含水、質地不受影響；只是沒有公開數字可以引用。請壓出空氣密封裝袋，並且維持密封回到室溫再打開。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍，冰的直接吃或稍微回溫即可。冰過的容器要等回到室溫才打開。
spoilage: 嚐起來苦而尖銳、久久不散——那是葵花油油耗。
聞起來像久放的油、蠟筆或油漆，而不是烘香。
罐子內壁或手指上有一層油膩薄膜。
tips: 開封後如果要吃上好幾個月，就移到冷藏。
用不透光的氣密罐；光線和溫度一樣要緊。
想要最長的保存期，就買生的、少量現烘。
拿去烘焙前先吃幾顆，苦味會進到成品裡。

faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 12 個月，開封後 3～4 個月；開封後 4 °C 以下冷藏 7～8 個月。
不是非得馬上冰，但它長時間放室溫會油耗，而冷藏大約能把開封後的壽命翻倍。
吃幾顆。油耗的種子苦得尖銳、有久放的油味。通常外觀看不出來，所以要用嚐的。
